birth_dates.original: Rabi' I 17, Year of the Elephant (Am al-Fil)

citations.quote: The famous opinion among Shi'a scholars is that the Prophet (s) was born on the seventeenth of Rabi' I.
Among Shi'a scholars, al-Shaykh al-Mufid and al-Shaykh al-Tusi have stated that it took place on the twenty-eighth of Safar

birth_dates.original: Jumada II 20, 5th year after Bi'tha (8 BH)

citations.quote: Based on the popular opinion amongst the Shia, she was born in the 5th year after bi'tha
In many Shia resources, Jumada II 20 is mentioned as Lady Fatima's (a) birthday.

death_dates.original: Jumada II 3, 11 AH (95 days; most commonly accepted)

citations.quote: The most commonly accepted view, according to the Shia, is that she passed away on Jumada II 3

death_dates.original: Jumada I 13, 11 AH (75 days; First Fatimiyya)

citations.quote: Based on another view, she passed away on Jumada I 13

death_dates.original: Rabi' II 8, 11 AH (40 days; Iraqi observance)

citations.quote: Iraqi Shi'as hold ceremonies in three of these reports: forty days after the demise of the Prophet (s) (Rabi' II 8), seventy-five days after it (Jumada I 13), and ninety-five days (Jumada II 3).
Other views on her passing are the Rabi' II 8, Rabi' II 13, and the Ramadan 3

notes.en: Popular birth is 20 Jumada II, five years after Bi'tha. The observed death days are 3 Jumada II, 13 Jumada I, and 8 Rabi II; 13 Rabi II is also reported. Lesser reports (72 days, three or six months, 3 Ramadan) are not kept.
notes.ar: المولد المشهور ٢٠ جمادى الآخرة، في السنة الخامسة للبعثة. أيام الوفاة المرعية: ٣ جمادى الآخرة، و١٣ جمادى الأولى، و٨ ربيع الآخر، ويُروى أيضاً ١٣ ربيع الآخر.

notes.en: Struck on Ramadan 19, 40 AH; martyred two days later per WikiShia.
notes.ar: ضُرب في ١٩ رمضان سنة ٤٠ هـ، واستُشهد بعد يومين بحسب ويكي شيعة.

later sources considered Shawwal 25 as the day of his martyrdom

death_dates.notes: Infobox: Safar 29 or Safar 30, 203. The popular observance is the last day of Safar.

notes.en: No exact birthday is recorded. Her name is given as Amina; she is known as Sukayna. Majority death report: Rabi' I 5, 117 AH.
notes.ar: لا يُروى تاريخ مولد محدد. اسمها آمنة، وتُعرف بسكينة. وفاتها في المشهور ٥ ربيع الأول ١١٧ هـ.

notes.en: WikiShia: no record of his birthday. Martyred on Ashura; some reports say he had not reached puberty, others that he was 16.
